resources.string: Says the glucose value and trend on the car speakers while you drive, when the value changes or is too low or too high.
You are in the car while the phone is connected to the car chosen under \"Car and test\".
Google activity recognition tells when you are in a vehicle. Needs the physical activity permission.
Inside the target range, the value is spoken only when it moved this much since the last time.
Repeat a low or a high every
A value below the low mark or above the high mark is spoken again after this time.
Choose the Bluetooth device of the car and test the voice

string.name: car_speech_current_car
string.comment: %1$s=name of the Bluetooth device of the car. Example: The car is: VW Radio

resources.string: Connect the phone to the car over Bluetooth. The device that connected last is shown here, and you can choose it as the car.
No Bluetooth audio device connected yet since this setting is on.

string.name: car_speech_use_as_car
string.comment: %1$s=name of a Bluetooth audio device. Example: Use VW Radio as the car

resources.string: In the car: the glucose value is spoken.
Not in the car: nothing is spoken.

string.name: car_speech_text
string.comment: Spoken text. %1$s=glucose value with no unit, %2$s=trend in words. Example: 7.2, rising

resources.string: Needed to know when you are driving, so the glucose value can be spoken in the car.
